changelog: Bilti-Driven Sales Item Filtering: Selecting a Bilti number now strictly filters the Item Description list to only products purchased in that specific batch
Eliminated duplicate product entries: Products purchased under different Biltis or batches are deduplicated and aggregated cleanly
Real-Time Out-of-Stock Status: Items with zero or depleted stock now clearly display 'Out of Stock' in both dropdowns and order lines
Optimized Line Item Flow: Bilti / Batch selector moved to the first position for streamlined batch-first item selection
Installation & Service Credits in P&L: Other credits (installation, labor, service charges) are now fully recognized in Profit & Loss and Sales reports as 100% gross profit
